text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Health Ministry plans measures to protect Kuwait from AIDS, Minister Anwar al-Nouri says.
- National Industries Company announces the formation of six subsidiaries with a total capital of six million dinars ($20 million).

- Deputy parliament speaker Talal al-Ayar says some 15,000 Kuwaitis unemployed. The government, which employes over 90 percent of the national workforce, says 3,232 Kuwaitis have standing applications for state jobs.
- Parliamentary sources say planning minister to announce new strategy to employ Kuwaitis in five ministries.
